Decentralized and Distributed are different. Centralized is like a monopoly (Your water supply comes from one place). Decentralized is a bit better, but like a cartel (there are a tiny number of options available for your ISP and they work loosely together.) Distributed is everywhere, like cats.

https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/comparison-centralized-decentralized-and-distributed-systems/

If something is centralized, like a cathedral or Voat website, it is easy to watch that church to see who goes there. You know where to go (the cathedral) and anybody going in or out is a user of that church. You can follow them (or their isp) to find out more about them.

If something is distributed, like a society of cat lovers or Aether, you don't really know where to go to begin with. If you one day, somehow, spotted somebody petting a cat somewhere, you could presumably add them to your list of cat lovers, but if you followed that cat lover around, there is a large chance they would never meet another cat lover and your efforts would be futile.

In Aether and distributed systems, it is difficult to trace the origin and destination of messages. It is a bit like cash. 12 Take heed, brethren, lest there be in any of you an evil heart of unbelief, in departing from the living God. (Hebrews 3:12 KJV)

What is an “evil heart of unbelief”? It is what the bible calls an evil conscience, which is caused by condemnation. It is one of Satan’s main inroads into the believer, and he is a master at trying to make one feel unworthy and condemned. The devil loves to put it into your conscience that God won’t heal you or help you in time of need, because you are just not worthy of His help. The churches commonly teach that also, as they like to make you feel unworthy and that you need to do a lot of works for the Lord to be blessed by Him. The bible says that we, who are born again, and walking in the spirit, should have no more consciousness of sin (Romans 8:1).

If you study the Word of God (Holy Bible), you will find out that it is not what you have done, or not done, that makes God move in your life, but what you have done about making Jesus Christ your Lord and Savior. If you are born again, you will want to serve the Lord, but whether you do or not, does not affect God’s love for you, but it will affect your love for God, and you do not have to be holy in your actions to receive from God. But to assure your eternal salvation, you must follow the commands of Jesus (Hebrews 5:9). Remember, your born again spirit is created in Holiness and Righteousness (Ephesians 4:24), and your relationship with God is by your spirit, and not by your actions, for God is a spirit (John 4:24). Praise God for His mercy.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
